metadata.title: Late 80s Pop R&B Multi-Pose Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio composition featuring four iterations of the same female subject in different dynamic poses, wearing a black mini-dress and bold red hoop earrings, arranged horizontally against a stark white background with a central typographic overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of subject to create a sense of movement and personality
High contrast between black garments and white background
Vibrant red accents (earrings) acting as focal points across the horizontal plane
Text overlapping the subjects to integrate graphic and photographic layers
coreInvariants: Horizontal alignment of figures from waist up

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four full-body figures (cropped at mid-thigh) distributed evenly across the frame, filling the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central typographic block in cyan, which bridges the gap between the middle two figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Left-to-right scanning following the different poses and facial expressions of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Pure white background surrounding the upper bodies and heads, providing high clarity for hair silhouettes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background) and Black (wardrobe) creating a high-contrast base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/Teal used for primary typography to pop against the black dresses.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Red for earrings and lipstick to add warmth and visual interest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (white) vs Low value (black) with high-saturation accents.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to White, Black, Cyan, and Red.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a simplified open loop

composition.position: Below primary text, right-aligned to the main block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large lowercase geometric sans paired with tiny uppercase condensed sans for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal text placement across multiple figures

preserve: Lowercase styling for the main name
Cyan color for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circular counters and 80s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a studio photograph of a woman with dark skin and high-ponytail braids, wearing a simple black spaghetti-strap mini-dress and large red hoop earrings. Composite four different poses of her side-by-side against a seamless white background. The poses should be expressive and dynamic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, lowercase, cyan-colored geometric sans-serif font across the center-bottom. Add a secondary title in small, white, uppercase condensed sans-serif font aligned to the bottom right of the primary name.

verificationChecks: Are there four distinct poses of the same person?
Is the background pure white without shadows?
Is the primary text cyan and lowercase?
Are the red earrings prominent in every pose?

adjustableVariables: Specific accessory color (e.g., changing red to yellow)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the black dress background.
Check that the four figures do not overlap in a messy or confusing way.
Verify the cyan color is vibrant and not muddy.
Confirm the red accents are consistent across all four figures.
recipe.reuseFormula: Multi-pose studio photography + high-key white background + high-contrast wardrobe + geometric cyan typography.
